instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nexus Enterprises is a regional fiber-optic broadband ISP focused on building and operating FTTH networks across rural and semi-urban municipalities, currently serving 35,000 subscribers. The company is strategically evaluating the transition to XGS-PON technology and planning an IPTV service launch to modernize its offering.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our digital transformation program has successfully delivered substantial operational efficiency, including a cloud ERP migration and a self-service data warehouse that resulted in €2.4M in annualized cost savings. We have also established a center of excellence for process automation using RPA to streamline back-office functions.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is market defense, focusing on retaining the existing installed base by enhancing switching costs and reducing churn through superior service delivery. We aim to provide a modern digital experience that matches competitor offerings without engaging in destructive price wars.
answers.additionalContext: The high regulatory environment in this region necessitates careful compliance management for any large-scale infrastructure changes, adding complexity to the short time horizon. Furthermore, significant capital expenditure is required for network upgrades, which competes directly with operational budget constraints.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: Churn Reduction Automation Suite (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Implement a low-code tool to automate personalized retention offers and proactively identify at-risk customers based on usage patterns and service degradation.

first_actions: Identify the top 10% churn risk segment.
Develop an MVP automation workflow for targeted SMS/email campaigns.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce 6-month subscriber churn by 5% with a target of 1,500 saved customers.
milestones: Month 1: Define automation triggers and scope.
Month 3: Deploy MVP retention workflow in one cluster.

opportunities.title: XGS-PON Service Tier Optimization (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Refine the XGS-PON upgrade strategy to ensure optimal cost recovery and service uptake, focusing on creating differentiated bundled packages rather than just infrastructure deployment.

first_actions: Model three distinct pricing tiers (Basic, Pro, Premium) for fiber bundles.
Conduct a competitive analysis of competitor IPTV/Internet hybrid offerings.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase average ARPU by 8% through bundled service adoption.
milestones: Month 2: Finalize pricing structure and SKU definitions.
Month 5: Roll out optimized bundles to pilot group.

opportunities.title: Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) Platform Integration (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Leverage the installed fiber infrastructure and data center capabilities to package network slicing or localized IoT connectivity services, allowing Nexus to monetize its passive assets rather than just selling bandwidth.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on using existing dark fiber capacity for private network testing.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Investment in new virtualization software licenses.
Pilot budget allocation of 3% of annual innovation spend.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure one pilot contract for a B2B private network service within the target geography.
milestones: Month 4: Complete feasibility and vendor selection.
Month 10: Launch first proof-of-concept (PoC) with key enterprise clients.

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated, cross-functional 'Defense Task Force' to prioritize and budget the XGS-PON upgrade roadmap.
Begin scouting and interviewing specialized external consultants focused on NaaS platform integration feasibility for radical opportunity testing.
Formalize a quarterly review process linking innovation output directly to market defense metrics (churn and ARPU).

key_weaknesses: Limited dedicated budget for experimentation (only 10% allocation) restricts rapid prototyping.
High dependency on a small, fully allocated technology team exacerbates 'talent' and 'time' barriers.
Formal innovation process clashes with the need for quick wins required by the short time horizon.
Lack of internal expertise in emerging B2B service models necessary for the radical opportunity.
